 School Holiday Today, November 4: Will schools remain closed on Wednesday? Check updates from Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, Odisha & Kerala as IMD issues heavy rain alerts
 SECTIONS School Holiday Today, November 4: Will schools remain closed on Wednesday? Check updates from Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, Odisha & Kerala as IMD issues heavy rain alerts By Trending Desk , ET Online Last Updated: Nov 04, 2026, 12:15:00 AM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis School holiday news: Schools in Andhra Pradesh will remain closed on November 4 and 5 due to preparations for the MPTC and ZPTC elections, with polling scheduled for November 5. Meanwhile, the IMD has issued heavy rainfall warnings for parts of Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Kerala, Odisha and Chhattisgarh on November 4, 2026. No statewide school holiday has been confirmed in Telangana or Kerala, while any closures in Odisha will depend on district-level orders. Parents and students should check local administration and school announcements for the latest updates.

 iStock School Holiday on November 4, 2026 Schools in Andhra Pradesh will remain closed today, Wednesday, November 4, ahead of the Mandal Parishad Territorial Constituency (MPTC) and Zilla Parishad Territorial Constituency (ZPTC) elections. The state government has declared holidays on November 4 and 5 for election-related arrangements, with polling scheduled for November 5 and counting on November 7. Meanwhile, the India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued heavy rainfall warnings for several parts of the country, including Coastal Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Kerala, Odisha and Chhattisgarh. Coastal Andhra Pradesh is likely to receive heavy to very heavy rainfall at isolated places, while isolated heavy showers are forecast in parts of Telangana and other regions.
 The weather department has also warned of thunderstorms, lightning and strong surface winds in some areas.
 Read more - Weather Today, November 4: Heavy rain alert for Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana & Chhattisgarh; IMD warns of flash flood risks in several districts 
 Andhra Pradesh school holiday today: Why will schools remain closed? 
Schools and educational institutions covered by the Andhra Pradesh government's election-related holiday order will remain closed on November 4 and 5.
The holiday on Wednesday has been announced to facilitate preparations for the MPTC and ZPTC elections. Polling will take place on November 5, followed by vote counting on November 7.
 Live Events
 The state has also been facing adverse weather conditions. The IMD has forecast heavy to very heavy rainfall at isolated places in Coastal Andhra Pradesh on November 4, along with thunderstorms, lightning and strong surface winds.
 The rainfall warning covers areas including Krishna, Bapatla, Prakasam, SPSR Nellore, Guntur, Eluru, NTR, Palnadu and West Godavari. Residents have been advised to follow local weather alerts and safety instructions.
 Telangana: Heavy showers likely in isolated areas
Telangana is also under a heavy rainfall warning for Wednesday. The IMD has forecast heavy showers at isolated places, following extremely heavy rainfall at isolated locations on November 3.
Districts including Khammam, Suryapet, Nalgonda, Nagarkurnool, Wanaparthy, Mahabubabad, Warangal, Jangaon, Karimnagar and Bhadradri Kothagudem should remain alert to changing weather conditions.
However, no statewide school holiday has been confirmed in Telangana. Parents and students should check announcements from their respective district administrations and schools.
 Kerala: Heavy rainfall warning continues
Kerala is likely to receive heavy rainfall at isolated places on November 4, according to the IMD's latest forecast. Thunderstorms and lightning are also expected in parts of the state.
Schools in areas experiencing persistent heavy showers could face disruptions if local authorities consider travel unsafe. However, a statewide school closure has not been confirmed.
Parents and students should follow updates from district administrations before heading to school.
 Odisha and Chhattisgarh: Rain warning for November 4
The IMD has forecast heavy rainfall at isolated places in Odisha on Wednesday, along with thunderstorms and lightning. Parts of southern Odisha, including Malkangiri, Koraput, Rayagada, Gajapati and Ganjam, have been covered by weather warnings.
Chhattisgarh is also likely to receive heavy rainfall at isolated places on November 4. Residents in affected areas have been advised to remain cautious and monitor local weather updates.
 School holiday today: Which states have confirmed closures?
Andhra Pradesh has announced holidays on November 4 and 5 for educational institutions covered by the MPTC and ZPTC election-related order. In Telangana and Kerala, no statewide school holiday has been confirmed as of the latest available updates.
In Odisha, closure announcements may apply to specific districts and should be checked with the respective district administrations.
Parents, students and teachers are advised to check official school and district-level announcements before travelling. An IMD rainfall warning does not automatically mean schools will remain closed across an entire state.
